blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY–Thousands of devotees from around the country joined the procession on Tuesday for the feast of St. Michael the Archangel, the patron of the predominantly Catholic city. Lourdes Alivio, 66, a devotee from Barangay Sta. Elena here, was among the throng in the procession, carrying her small statues of St. Michael the Archangel and Santo Niño. She said she prayed for peace in the city and safety from disaster. Alivio said she also implored the saints to help solve the city’s long-running problems. “I prayed that the problem of garbage and (lack of) potable water would be solved.” READ: Water rationing […]...
